hero.title: TSCG increases revenue 30 percent
hero.kicker: The key to success for The Shopping Center Group (TSCG) is giving clients the best local market knowledge. As the leading retail-only real estate company in the United States, TSCG delivers accurate psychographic data and spatial analysis with ArcGIS technology. Clients can quickly understand markets and seize opportunities.

strengthen.title: Grow sales with precision
strengthen.paragraph: All transactions happen in a specific place, which influences customer preferences and behavior. Use ArcGIS technology to understand why transactions happen where they do. Insight from advanced spatial analysis empowers retailers to make informed decisions. Enrich customer experiences, select profitable sites, and increase incremental sales.

imageSection.title: Know where customers live, work, and shop
imageSection.description: Map and analyze customer and demographic data. Make data-driven decisions about site selection, marketing, and product assortment.

features.title: Understand why purchases happen where they do
features.paragraph: Maps and spatial analysis strengthen inventory and marketing decisions. See how and where customers interact with your brand.

features.title: Determine the best store locations
features.paragraph: Forecast profitable sites based on competitive presence, potential customer demographics, access to supply chains, and more.

features.title: Make real-time decisions with real-time data
features.paragraph: Incorporate up-to-the-minute data on customer and vehicle locations, assets, sales, and environments into maps and analysis.

empower1.title: Bring precision to all divisions
empower1.paragraph: Empower staff with ArcGIS technology. Strengthen planning, operations, and growth.
